1.explanation:
• rating/index.md & index.en-us.md: Show the documented API for Rating (including id and onChange), so you understand how id is intended to work.  
• rating/adaptor/index.jsx: Contains the core implementation, prop forwarding, event handling, and likely the duplicate onChange trigger when id is added.  
• rating/theme/index.jsx: Defines the rendered markup (stars + inputs), which explains how id may end up applied to multiple elements.  
• rating/demo/basic.md: Demonstrates the simplest usage without id; use this to compare behavior.  
• rating/demo/accessibility.md: Shows the hidden input strategy and use of id/for for labels; useful to reproduce the duplicate event scenario tied to id propagation.
1.bug_scenario: In the reproduction screenshot, a <Rating> component is rendered with an id prop (“score”) and an onChange handler that logs the selected value. When the user clicks to change the rating, each click emits two console.info logs instead of one. The underlying <Rating> renders a set of clickable stars (and hidden inputs for accessibility), and adding the id prop appears to cause the onChange handler to fire twice on a single click.
